properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 27 at 9:28AM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
At 927 AM CDT, Doppler radar was tracking the leading edge of winds
from strong thunderstorms along a line extending from 6 miles north
of Cookietown to 4 miles northwest of Holliday to 4 miles southeast
of Vera. Movement was southeast at 35 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Wichita Falls, Altus, Vernon, Burkburnett, Frederick, Henrietta,
Seymour, Quanah, Walters, Archer City, Munday, Knox City, Crowell,
Benjamin, Iowa Park, Electra, Holliday, Grandfield, Temple, and
Tipton.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 27 at 10:14AM EDT until August 27 at 1:15PM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Bergen County in northeastern New Jersey...
Passaic County in northeastern New Jersey...
Southern Orange County in southeastern New York...
Rockland County in southeastern New York...

* WHEN...Until 115 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1014 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch of rain has
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are expected over the
area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
West Milford, Monsey, Ramsey, Ringwood, Pompton Lakes, Suffern,
Sloatsburg, Bloomingdale, Greenwood Lake, Spring Valley, Oakland,
Wanaque, Airmont, Hillcrest, New Square, Viola, Wesley Hills, New
Hempstead, Montebello and Hillburn.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 27 at 10:11AM EDT until August 27 at 10:45AM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL out 20 NM...
Waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1045 AM EDT.

* At 1011 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 19 nm north of R
Tower, moving northwest at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* The strong thunderstorm will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor immediately as gusty winds and high waves are
expected.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 26 at 1:04PM CDT until August 30 at 4:00AM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Illinois...Indiana...

Wabash River from Montezuma to Mount Carmel.

White River from Petersburg to Hazleton.

.Minor flooding continues along the lower White River from Petersburg
to Hazleton. Minor flooding also continues on the Wabash River from
Montezuma down to Mount Carmel with the crest at Vincennes. Rain
amounts with scattered storms this evening are not expected to impact
main stem river levels, but locally heavy rainfall in a basin could
cause a bump in stage as well as lengthen the amount of time in
flood.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Riverton.

* WHEN...Until late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...At 20.7 feet, Leaverton Park at Palestine, Illinois
extensively floods including the campground area.  Rodeo area still
dry at this level. Most if not all local unimproved roads leading
to the Wabash River in the Palestine area are impassable by any
land vehicle.  Extensive backwater flooding of Minnow Slough, Sugar
Creek and Lamotte Creek in Palestine area. Numerous river cabins
surrounded by water across the river from Merom Bluff. Backyards of
a few residences southeast of Palestine along East River Road
flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 12:00 PM CDT /1:00 PM EDT/ Wednesday the stage was 20.8 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 12:00 PM CDT /1:00 PM EDT/ Wednesday was 21.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage
Saturday afternoon and continue falling to 7.6 feet Saturday,
September 05.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. Most flood related deaths occur
in automobiles. Do not attempt to cross water covered bridges, dips,
or low water crossings. Never try to cross a flowing stream, even a
small one, on foot. To escape rising water find another route over
higher ground.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued Thursday morning at 700 AM CDT /800
AM EDT/.
